newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Air Force drops plans to court-martial pilot.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Air Force drops plans to court-martial pilot.

text.p: The U.S. Air Force will not court-martial its first female bomber pilot, Lt. Kelly Flinn, on adultery and other charges based on a compromise agreement reached with her, a senior defence official said on Thursday.

Details of the deal were not immediately announced. But the defence official, who asked not to be identified, said the Air Force had decided to drop plans for the court martial at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, based on the compromise.

Flinn, involved in a major confrontation with the service over her alleged affair with the husband of an enlisted woman and charges of having sex with an enlisted man, had offered to resign with an honourable discharge.

But Air Force officials said earlier in the week that Air Force Secretary Sheila Widnall, despite political pressure from members of Congress to go easy on Flinn, was not inclined to accept an honourable discharge.
